name: IBY_TANGIBLE
description: IBY_TANGIBLE stores information about the bills or orders.

columns.name: MTANGIBLEID
columns.description: system generated ID, this id is exposed to Electronic application unlike others

columns.name: TANGIBLEID
columns.description: Bill or order identifier

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount

columns.name: CURRENCYNAMECODE
columns.description: code for currency name such USD

columns.name: ACCTNO
columns.description: customer account number with the biller or merchant

columns.name: REFINFO
columns.description: any reference information passed by the Electronic Commerce Application

columns.name: MEMO
columns.description: memo for the payment

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SECURITY_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Used in hosted environments

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of the originating EC App quote or order. Foreign Key to JTF_OBJECTS_B

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Primary Key of the source object

columns.name: ISSUEDATE
columns.description: Date the Bills Receivable or Receipt was issued. Added for AR-BR integration

columns.name: ORDER_MEDIUM
columns.description: Order medium/channel from lookup type IBY_ORDER_MEDIUM_TYPE

columns.name: EFT_AUTH_METHOD
columns.description: Method used in obtaining authorization  for performing EFT debits against the payer's bank account

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Id to support multi-tenancy
